intent: avoid false EKF failsafes caused by short variance spikes
root_cause: EKF_CHECK_ITERATIONS_MAX raised from 10 to 150 iterations at 10 Hz, so a real position loss takes ~15 s longer to trigger the failsafe
good_fix: keep the 1 s check; tune FS_EKF_THRESH or filter spikes instead of delaying detection of sustained bad variance
